title: Mixed supervision for surface-defect detection: from weakly to fully supervised learning
mechanism: Segmentation + image-level classification network trained on any mix of pixel-level and image-level labels.
evidence: KolektorSDD2, DAGM, Severstal: few pixel labels plus many weak labels approach full supervision.
adaptation: ELPV 2,624 cells (BMRK source): cell-level defect head; p=0 cells give full-image negatives for crack/inactive; p=1 cells MIL positives. De-duplicate ELPV against BenchmarkEL val/test BMRK cells and modules first.
min_experiment: Arm: house + cell head + ELPV weak labels, 20k steps, 5 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed. Metric: BMRK inactive IoU on module-grouped 5-fold CV, crack pixel precision. Kill if BMRK inactive IoU < +0.05 and crack precision not up. ~8 GPU-h.
prior_overlap: none; ELPV image labels listed as unused

alt_notes.adaptation: Image-level crack-present / inactive-present heads on U-Net++ bottleneck + pooled seg logits; train on 478 masks plus ELPV 2,624 image labels (BMRK source) and PVEL-AD boxes as image labels; seg loss only where masks exist.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm PF + presence heads + ELPV image labels; baseline PF; metrics BMRK crack IoU, inactive CV IoU, E1 inactive IoU; kill if BMRK crack IoU gain < 0.02 and inactive CV IoU gain < 0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add an image-level head (crack present, inactive present) on the U-Net++ bottleneck and the seg logits. Train it on mask-derived labels from the 478 cells, on ELPV's 2,624 cells with defect-probability labels (ELPV is the BMRK source, our weakest), and on PVEL-AD boxes reduced to image labels. The seg loss applies only to masked cells.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + presence heads + ELPV image labels. Baseline: PF. Metrics: BMRK crack and inactive IoU, inactive precision, E1 inactive IoU. Kill if the BMRK crack IoU gain is < 0.02 and the CV inactive IoU gain is < 0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Dilate 1-2 px crack labels to the 4-5 px dark-line FWHM and weight by distance to the label centreline (p=1 or 2), negatives weight 1; add crack-present / inactive-present cell heads so ELPV image labels (2,624 cells) can enter as weak data.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + dilated crack label with DT weights (p=1, p=2); baseline: house; metric: 5-fold CV crack relF1@2 and strict IoU; kill if relF1@2 < +0.01 or IoU drops > 0.01. Arm 1b adds stop-grad cls head, kill if cell-level crack recall < +0.02.
